assertions.text: The calibration layer reduces expected calibration error from 8.4% to 6.3% on ImageNet.
assertions.subject: calibration layer
assertions.evidence: On ImageNet, the calibration layer reduces expected calibration error from 8.4% to 6.3%.

assertions.text: Under severity-3 ImageNet-C shift, the calibration layer keeps expected calibration error below 7.0%.
assertions.subject: calibration layer
assertions.evidence: Under distribution shift (ImageNet-C, severity 3), the layer keeps the error below 7.0%.

assertions.text: The calibration layer adds 0.4 ms per image at inference time.
assertions.subject: calibration layer
assertions.evidence: The layer adds 0.4 ms per image at inference time.

assertions.text: The gain persists with only 100 calibration samples in most cases.
assertions.subject: calibration layer
assertions.evidence: In most cases the gain persists when only 100 calibration samples are used.
